text: We have the client presentation on Thursday. Have you thought about how we should divide it? Yes, how about you present the budget section and I handle the project timeline? That split makes sense. Should we rehearse together on Wednesday afternoon? Wednesday afternoon works, and we can use the small meeting room upstairs. I will reserve the room from two to three. Can you print the handouts before we practice? Sure, I will print twenty copies and bring them to the rehearsal. Could you also bring a digital copy in case we need to change the timeline? Yes, I will bring an editable version as well as the printed handouts. Great. Let us leave ten minutes at the end of rehearsal for possible client questions. Good idea. We can prepare answers to the questions they are most likely to ask.
